name: X-Madrid Open 2026
information:
La competición se celebrará dentro del evento "VI Edición del Orgullo Friki".
The competition will be a part of the "VI Edition of Geek Pride" event.
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTc1NDg4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ea41ba46d72d045cc1ab194d2b2b61b830829b59/Cartel%20X-Madrid%202026.jpeg)

El registro in situ tendrá lugar de 9:30h a 10:00. Después de esta hora no se aceptarán nuevos competidores.
On-site registration will take place from 9:30 a.m. to 10:00 a.m. No new competitors will be accepted after this time.
